title: MedlinePlus: Information for Trainers and Librarians
content: Information for Trainers and Librarians The goal of MedlinePlus is to present high-quality, relevant health and wellness information that is trusted, easy to understand, and free of advertising, in both English and Spanish. We appreciate your efforts in teaching people how to use MedlinePlus. Here are some training resources which might help you with your classes and outreach activities. Resources for Using and Teaching MedlinePlus Webinars Using PubMed, MedlinePlus, and other National Library of Medicine Resources . From the Federal Depository Library Program Measles, Immunizations, and Finding Accurate Health Information with MedlinePlus . If so, please contact us .
